# Anchorage Daily News

> Alaska's leading news source covering Anchorage local news, Alaska business, and community information with job boards, classifieds, and visitor guides.

Anchorage Daily News (ADN) is a comprehensive local news platform serving Southcentral Alaska with daily journalism, business coverage through the Alaska Journal of Commerce, classified marketplaces, and community resources. The site operates as a nonprofit-supported media organization with multiple revenue streams including job listings, real estate classifieds, and advertising partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Anchorage local news
- Alaska business news
- Alaska Journal of Commerce
- Energy and LNG projects
- Job board and employment
- Real estate classifieds
- Opinion and commentary
- Mobile app
- Email newsletters
- Nonprofit fundraising
- Community guides
- Visitor information
- Sponsored content
- Local Media Foundation
- Alaska economic development

## News & Content

- [Today's Paper](http://www.adn.com/todays-paper): Daily newspaper front page and news roundup for Anchorage Daily News
- [Alaska Journal of Commerce](https://www.adn.com/alaska-journal): Alaska Journal of Commerce business news covering energy, LNG, and economic development
- [Opinions](https://www.adn.com/section/opinions): Opinion section with letters to editor and local political commentary
- [Sponsored Content](https://www.adn.com/section/sponsored-content): Sponsored content partnerships with local businesses and nonprofits

## Jobs & Classifieds

- [Job Board](https://jobs.adn.com): Job board and employment portal for Alaska job search and hiring
- [Classified Marketplace](https://marketplace.adn.com/marketplace): Classified marketplace for job listings, real estate, and community services
- [Self-Service Advertising](https://adportal.adn.com/adportal/classified/index.html): Self-service advertising platform for classified ads and obituary placement

## Engagement & Subscriptions

- [Newsletters](https://www.adn.com/newsletter): Email newsletter signup for daily Alaska and Anchorage news updates
- [Mobile App](https://www.adn.com/app): Mobile app and advertising opportunities for Anchorage Daily News
- [Advertise with ADN](https://www.adn.com/app): Advertising opportunities and partnerships with Anchorage Daily News

## Community Resources

- [Alaska Visitors Guide](https://www.adn.com/alaska-visitors-guide): Alaska visitor guide featuring Denali, hiking, fishing, and outdoor adventures
- [Summer Camp Guide](https://www.adn.com/summer-camps): Comprehensive 2026 summer camp guide for kids in Anchorage and Alaska

## About & Support

- [Careers](https://www.adn.com/careers): Career opportunities at Anchorage Daily News newsroom and departments
- [Donate](http://on.adn.com/donate): Donation campaign for Anchorage Daily News via Local Media Foundation
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.adn.com/troubleshooting): Login help and troubleshooting guide for ADN website and mobile app
